transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

I... well, I suppose I'm here because of the things I've been hearing. Just... voices. Very clear voices in my apartment. And sometimes if I'm out, like in empty museum rooms. 

It's just... women whispering from behind the walls. Telling me... telling me which photographs belong in the archive. That's... that's why I'm here.
About how long have you been hearing these voices?

I suppose... it's been about eight months. Yes, around eight months since the whispering started. And... well, that's also how long I've been certain that people are watching my archive. Just... eight months.
During these past eight months, have you been feeling significantly down, depressed, or hopeless?
I... no. Not really. I wouldn't say I feel depressed. I've just been... very focused on the work. The archive takes up a lot of my time, so... no. I don't think so.
Have you been using any recreational drugs, alcohol, or new medications around the time these experiences started?
No. I... I don't use things like that. Just my regular blood pressure pill, but I've been on that for years. Nothing new. Just... the work.
Have you had any periods where you felt unusually energetic, on top of the world, or needed much less sleep than usual?

I... well, yes. I don't need much sleep lately. Two or three hours is enough. I wake up before dawn and... I just feel completely ready to go. I tell myself that sleep is... well, it's for people who don't have an archive to rescue. So, I just get up and get back to it.
About how long have you been experiencing this high energy and needing only a few hours of sleep?

I... I suppose it's been about six months. Out of the last eight or so. Just these... bursts. Where I'm not sleeping, and my head is just racing with all the plans. I've had to... spend some money on things for it, too. Just... a lot of furious energy, I guess. But yes, about six months.
Have there been times, for at least a couple of weeks, when you heard the voices or felt watched while your sleep and energy levels were completely normal?

Yes... I suppose there was a time like that. For a few weeks. I wasn't... I didn't have all that energy. I was just sleeping normally. But... I still heard the whispers in the apartment. And I... well, I still knew the arts people were monitoring my phone. That didn't stop.
